correctness.rationale: The finite proof reconstructs GF(4), all 85 points and 85 planes of PG(3,4), and the exact printed generator. It first reproduces the published plane spectrum, then exhaustively counts incident residue-0 planes at every point. The 16 exceptional planes consist of 12 multiplicity-4 and 4 multiplicity-8 planes; their point-depth histogram is 2,1,16,9,25,23,2,7. The unique depth-one point is (0,0,1,3), the source plane [1,1,0,0] is an incident 8-plane, and the total incidence count 336 equals 16·21. The standalone verifier replays all assertions and prints VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The source introduces a genuinely local invariant and uses a single explicit center as its motivating example. A complete center census is therefore a natural classification of that example: it shows the exhibited 1-local center is rigidly unique while 2-local centers are substantially more numerous. This pointwise geometry is invisible in the global plane spectrum and is directly relevant when testing or applying the paper’s local necessary conditions.
